meta_description: Tree Surgeon Nottingham offers expert tree surgery, felling, pruning and stump removal. Fully insured. Local arborist serving Nottingham and surrounding areas.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured Arborist — Emergency Tree Work Available
hero_subhead: Dead limbs hanging over your house? We safely remove, prune and fell trees, then dispose of the lot.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From routine pruning to emergency storm damage removal, we handle every aspect of tree care safely and professionally.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe removal of dead, diseased or unwanted trees. We use modern rigging techniques to fell trees in tight spaces, then chip or remove all waste.

services.title: Crown Thinning & Pruning
services.desc: Improve light and air circulation through your garden by thinning crowns, or shape mature trees to keep them healthy and manageable.

services.title: Hedge Cutting & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge trims to tidy boundaries and encourage dense growth. We handle overgrown hedges safely with all rubbish cleared.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Grind out awkward stumps flush to ground level or remove them entirely. Leaves your garden level and ready to replant.

services.title: Storm Damage & Emergency Work
services.desc: Broken branches and fallen trees? We respond quickly to clear hazardous limbs and fallen timber, 24/7.

services.title: Tree Care Surveys & Advice
services.desc: Professional assessment of tree health and safety. We identify problem trees early and recommend the best action to protect your property.

about_pullquote: I started this business because trees matter — and shoddy work leaves them dying.
about_para_1: We've been climbing and felling trees across Nottingham for nearly two decades. Built on a reputation for honest advice and meticulous workmanship, we've helped thousands of homeowners and businesses manage their trees safely. All our arborists are trained to the highest standards and fully insured.
about_para_2: Customers come back because we don't over-sell. We assess every tree properly, give you straight advice, and only recommend what's genuinely needed. Whether it's a routine prune or emergency storm damage, you'll find us punctual, tidy, and thorough.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had three massive overhanging branches that were keeping light out of the kitchen. Came out same day, assessed the job properly, and felled them without a scratch to the fence. All the chips cleared away. Really professional outfit.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: After the storm knocked a huge oak branch into the shed, I rang expecting to wait weeks. They were here within four hours and had everything safe and cleared by end of day. Fair price too, no hidden extras.
reviews.author: Margaret S.

reviews.text: Absolute lifesaver. The stump in our garden was impossible to get out. They ground it and levelled the whole lot. Garden's usable again. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Tom H.
